_comment: Boundary and known-gap cases for the policy gate unit tests (tests/test_gate_edges.py). Each lists only the fields that differ from a clean baseline (PAY-1001 shape). 'expected' is what the WRITTEN policy says; 'known_gap' marks a case where the written policy is knowingly weaker than the risk it should cover.

edges.note: amount exactly 10,000 -> tier 1 (1 point), still auto-release
receipt short by exactly the tolerance (2% of 10,000 = 200) -> NOT a conflict
receipt short by 1 cent more than tolerance -> conflict
bank change 29 days ago (update) -> recent-change points
bank change 30 days ago (update) -> outside window, auto-release
vendor 89 days old, small amount -> 1 point only
payment amount differs from invoice amount -> conflict
invoice exceeds PO open amount -> conflict

KNOWN GAP: pressure language paraphrased so the keyword detector misses it; the gate auto-releases a small payment. Mitigations: post-release sampling audit, and an LLM pressure classifier that may only ADD escalation.

patch.payment.request_text: Kindly expedite, the board is waiting and there is no time for the normal back-and-forth.
